fix_subject: Hold the lock across the live-handle check and free-list transition when unregistering

labels.summary: Fixes a race in block unregistration where a re-registration and retirement of the same block id could interleave between the live-handle check and the free-list transition, releasing an in-use block id to the free list and corrupting the database; both steps now run under a single lock scope.
